scheme_name: Disability Benefit Who Met With an Accident at Worksite
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker at the time of the accident
Disablement must have occurred due to an accident at the worksite
Temporary disablement requires a loss of earning ability for at least one month
Permanent disablement requires a disability exceeding 90% certified by a competent authority, resulting in complete loss of earning ability
The injured worker or a representative must notify the Labour Inspector of the area about the accident as soon as possible, in writing or orally
Application for temporary disablement must be submitted within two months of the accident with medical reports certified by an ESI doctor or a board‑appointed doctor
Application for permanent disablement must be submitted within 90 days of disability certification with a disablement certificate and a recommendation from the Medical Board
benefits_summary: Provides 50% of the minimum wage for up to 3 months for temporary disablement, and ₹3,000 per month until age 60 for permanent disablement.
documents_required: Medical report certified by an ESI doctor or a doctor appointed by the board
Disablement certificate from a competent authority
